quality_guards: Lone-working risk depends on the task, workplace, isolation, worker competence and health, available supervision, communications and emergency-response arrangements.
HSE lone-working guidance is worker-, task-, site-, supervision-, communication- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level harm probability.
Work-related violence risk depends on role, contact with the public, location, lone work, prior incidents, staffing, controls, reporting and response capacity.
HSE violence evidence is workplace-, role-, worker-, control-, incident- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level violence probability.
Slip-and-trip risk depends on surface condition, contamination, task, cleaning, footwear, lighting, weather, housekeeping and the people using the area.
HSE slip-and-trip evidence is surface-, activity-, user-, maintenance-, weather- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level injury probability.
Asbestos risk depends on the building, ACM type and condition, accessibility, occupancy, maintenance and refurbishment plans, disturbance likelihood and management controls.
HSE asbestos evidence is building-, material-, condition-, activity-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level exposure probability.
Meningococcal risk depends on serogroup, immunity, vaccination, contact intensity, shared setting, symptoms, host factors and timing.
UKHSA meningococcal evidence is case-, contact-, vaccine-, setting-, host- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level infection probability.
Heat-health impact depends on temperature, duration, region, exposure, housing, age, health status, vulnerability and response capacity.
UKHSA alert evidence is weather-, region-, population-, vulnerability-, response- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level mortality probability.
E-bike battery risk depends on cell quality, design, BMS performance, charger compatibility, damage, charging behaviour, environment and foreseeable misuse.
OPSS battery evidence is product-, charger-, use-, damage-, environment-, control- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level fire probability.
Drone risk depends on aircraft weight and class, operating category, people, location, weather, speed, airspace restrictions and authorisation.
CAA Drone Code evidence is aircraft-, pilot-, operation-, location-, weather-, authorisation- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level incident probability.
Level-crossing risk depends on crossing type, train and road traffic, user profile, sighting, warning and protection systems, maintenance and changing local conditions.
ORR crossing evidence is route-, crossing-, train-, road-user-, control-, maintenance- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level collision probability.
Flood harm depends on the flood source, forecast, terrain, drainage, property, warning lead time, vulnerability, available support and response.
Environment Agency flood evidence is forecast-, location-, property-, population-, response- and time-specific and is not an exact parcel-level harm probability.
